report_topic: Performance Audit of Management of Odisha Mineral Bearing Areas Development Corporation Funds
observations_summary: The audit found significant deficiencies in the management of Odisha Mineral Bearing Areas Development Corporation Funds across six sectors. Issues included inadequate planning, non-recovery of compensation, unspent balances, project delays, avoidable expenditures due to overlapping, non-completion of projects, and lack of effective monitoring and internal controls, ultimately depriving beneficiaries of intended services.
